summary.text: Steve Arentz is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 36 who joined the House in November 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former restaurant owner and current Realtor, he serves on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steve Arentz was born in Hollywood, California, on April 17, 1951, and attended Control Data Institute in Pittsburgh and Newbury Junior College in Brookline, Massachusetts, according to his General Assembly biography.
He owned and operated Hemingway's Restaurant and Lola's Sunset Grill in Stevensville from 1996 to 2010 and has been a Realtor with Long & Foster since 2003.

Arentz chaired the Queen Anne's County Chamber of Commerce in 2005 to 2006 and the county's Economic Development Commission from 2007 to 2010, and he served as a Queen Anne's County commissioner from 2010 to 2013.
Arentz was appointed to the House of Delegates on November 8, 2013, and sworn in on November 19, 2013.
He has served on the Economic Matters Committee since 2015, was Deputy Minority Whip from 2017 to 2021, and has chaired the Queen Anne's County Delegation since 2014.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
